body.zh-Hant: 西美昂二世1937年出生，是保加利亞沙皇鮑里斯三世之子。1943年夏天鮑里斯三世猝然去世，享年49歲，留下由三人組成的攝政團，代表年僅六歲的西美昂統治。
body.en: Simeon II was born in 1937, the son of Tsar Boris III of Bulgaria. In the summer of 1943 Boris died suddenly at the age of 49, leaving a three-man regency to rule for his six-year-old son.

citations.quote: "dateOfBirth" : [ "1937" ]
Simeon II, exiled son of Tsar Boris III
In the summer of 1943, Boris died suddenly at age 49
leaving a three-man regency ruling for his six-year-old son, Simeon

heading.en: The regency and the change of regime

body.zh-Hant: 國別研究指出，三名攝政中有兩人只是傀儡，身兼首相的第三名攝政鮑格丹·菲洛夫成為事實上的國家元首。1944年9月9日，祖國陣線聯盟以不流血政變推翻臨時政府，政府由基蒙·格奧爾基耶夫領導。
body.en: The country study notes that two of the three regents were figureheads, so that Prime Minister Bogdan Filov, the third regent, became de facto head of state. On 9 September 1944 the Fatherland Front coalition deposed the temporary government in a bloodless coup, and the new administration was headed by Kimon Georgiev.

citations.quote: Because two of the three regents were figureheads
Prime Minister Bogdan Filov, the third regent, became de facto head of state
On September 9, 1944, five days after the Soviet declaration of war
a Fatherland Front coalition deposed the temporary government in a bloodless
Headed by Kimon Georgiev of Zveno

heading.en: End of the reign and exile

body.zh-Hant: 德國國家圖書館的人名權威檔記載，他1943至1946年以沙皇身分在位。1946年9月的全國公民投票以壓倒多數決定廢除君主制，宣布保加利亞為人民共和國。此事導致年僅九歲的西美昂二世立即流亡。
body.en: The authority record of the German National Library states that he reigned as tsar from 1943 to 1946. In a national referendum in September 1946 an overwhelming majority voted to abolish the monarchy and proclaim Bulgaria a people's republic. This led to the immediate exile of Simeon II, the nine-year-old son of Boris III.

citations.quote: regierte als Zar 1943-1946
In a national referendum in September 1946
voted to abolish the monarchy and proclaim Bulgaria a people's republic
leading to the immediate exile of Simeon II, nine-year-old son of Boris III

heading.zh-Hant: 君主派運動與後來的首相任期
heading.en: The monarchist movement and later premiership

body.zh-Hant: 1991年時他54歲，在流亡中仍受許多保加利亞人歡迎，是一個小而重要的君主派運動的中心。他表示若人民希望復辟便願意回國，但1991年新憲法把保加利亞定為共和國，官方不再考慮復辟。德國國家圖書館的權威檔另記他2001至2005年任保加利亞總理。
body.en: In 1991, aged 54, he remained popular with many Bulgarians and was the center of a small but significant monarchist movement. He agreed to return if his people wished a restoration, but the new constitution of 1991 described Bulgaria as a republic and ended official consideration of restoration. The German National Library authority record also notes that he was prime minister of Bulgaria in 2001-2005.

body.zh-Hant: 1870年12月14日生於摩拉維亞的翁特坦諾維茨（今多爾尼杜納約維采），是一個貧困農家的第18個、也是最小的孩子。他在維也納大學修習法律，1889至1894年就讀，1898年取得法學博士；1895年起在維也納帝國議會圖書館任職，並以「Synopticus」等筆名出版小冊子。
body.en: Born on 14 December 1870 at Untertannowitz (Dolní Dunajovice) in Moravia, the eighteenth and youngest child of an impoverished farming family. He studied law at the University of Vienna from 1889 to 1894 and took his doctorate in 1898. From 1895 he held a post in the Reichsrat library in Vienna, and he published pamphlets under pseudonyms such as Synopticus.

18. und jüngstes Kind einer verarmten Bauernfamilie
stud. 1889–94 an der Univ. Wien Jus, 1898 Dr. jur.
bekam er 1895 einen Posten in der Reichsratsbibl. in Wien
Broschüren unter den Pseudonymen Synopticus und Rudolf Springer

heading.zh-Hant: 帝國議會議員與地方政治

body.zh-Hant: 1907年6月17日起，他以社會民主黨人身分擔任帝國議會眾議院（Abgeordnetenhaus）議員，ÖBL 寫他在紐基興取得席位；1908年也當選下奧地利邦議會議員，任職至1921年。1911年起他積極投入合作社運動；直到戰爭結束，他都主張保存多瑙君主國。1918年10月21日，帝國議會德語區議員組成德意志奧地利臨時國民議會，他是成員之一。
body.en: From 17 June 1907 he sat as a Social Democrat in the Abgeordnetenhaus of the Reichsrat; the ÖBL says he won a mandate at Neunkirchen. In 1908 he was also elected to the Lower Austrian Landtag, of which he remained a member until 1921. From 1911 he became strongly active in the cooperative movement, and until the end of the war he argued for preserving the Danube Monarchy. On 21 October 1918 the German-speaking deputies of the Reichsrat constituted themselves as the Provisional National Assembly of German Austria, and he was a member.

1908 auch in den niederösterr. Landtag gewählt, dem er bis 1921 angehörte
ab 1911 war er auch stark in der Genossenschaftsbewegung tätig
trat er bis zum Kriegsende für die Erhaltung der Donaumonarchie ein
Am 21.10.1918 konstituierten sich die 1911 gewählten Abgeordneten

heading.zh-Hant: 國務總理與聖日耳曼和約
heading.en: State Chancellor and the Treaty of Saint-Germain

body.zh-Hant: 1918年10月30日，他出任國務總理府（Staatskanzlei）負責人；同日臨時國民議會通過由他起草的憲法。1919年3月15日起他任國務總理，至1920年7月7日。他是奧地利代表團團長，簽署了聖日耳曼條約。1919年7月26日起他先後任外交國務院負責人與外交國務秘書，直到1920年10月22日。ÖBL 稱他1920年離開政府。
body.en: On 30 October 1918 he became head of the State Chancellery, and on the same day the Provisional National Assembly adopted a constitution that he had drafted. From 15 March 1919 until 7 July 1920 he was State Chancellor. As leader of the Austrian delegation he had to sign the Treaty of Saint-Germain. From 26 July 1919 he headed the State Office for Foreign Affairs and then served as State Secretary there, until 22 October 1920. The ÖBL notes that he left the government in 1920.

body.zh-Hant: 1920年11月10日起他是國民議會議員，先屬社會民主黨團，任期至1930年10月1日，1930年12月2日起再任至1934年2月17日。1923年他創立勞工銀行（Arbeiterbank）。1931年4月29日至1933年3月4日他擔任國民議會議長；ÖBL 稱他1933年3月4日應黨的要求辭去此職。1934年他曾短暫被捕。
body.en: From 10 November 1920 he sat in the National Council for the Social Democrats, until 1 October 1930, and again from 2 December 1930 until 17 February 1934. In 1923 he founded the Arbeiterbank. From 29 April 1931 to 4 March 1933 he was President of the National Council; the ÖBL says he resigned that office on 4 March 1933 at his party's request. In 1934 he was briefly arrested.

heading.en: The Second Republic and the federal presidency

body.zh-Hant: 1945年他出任臨時政府的國務總理；4月27日他宣讀共和國獨立宣言。12月20日聯邦大會一致選他為聯邦總統，任期為1945年12月20日至1950年12月31日。他在1950年12月31日於維也納去世。
body.en: In 1945 he became State Chancellor of the provisional government, and on 27 April he read out the declaration of independence of the Republic of Austria. On 20 December the Federal Assembly unanimously elected him Federal President, an office he held from 20 December 1945 to 31 December 1950. He died in Vienna on 31 December 1950.

body.zh-Hant: 1845年8月16日生於卑爾根附近法納的斯滕德。父親在斯滕德買下農場並經營磨坊。1864年中學畢業後他到克里斯蒂安尼亞學習法律，但從未讀完；1868年他與尼爾斯·尤爾在松霍達蘭的哈爾斯諾伊創辦民眾高等學校，1872至1873年又在耶倫（Jæren）的莫西格（Mossige）開辦同類學校。
body.en: Born on 16 August 1845 at Stend in Fana near Bergen. His father had bought a farm at Stend and ran a mill there. After finishing school in 1864 he went to Christiania to study law but never completed the degree. In 1868 he founded a folk high school at Halsnøy in Sunnhordland together with Niels Juel, and in 1872-1873 he held a folk high school at Mossige in Jæren.

heading.zh-Hant: 自由黨創建者與國會議員

body.zh-Hant: 1877至1879年他是斯托庭的第一候補議員，1880至1888年連任三屆議員；1884年他參與創建自由黨（Venstre），並在全國理事會任職到1889年，最後一年為副主席。1880年起他還擔任地方村長，至1901年，中間僅兩次中斷。1888年自由黨分裂時他站在「純粹派」最前面，隨後落選，政治生涯暫告中斷。
body.en: In 1877-1879 he was first deputy representative to the Storting, and from 1880 to 1888 he served three terms as a representative. In 1884 he took part in founding the Venstre party and sat on its national board until 1889, as deputy chairman in the last year. From 1880 to 1901 he was also the local mayor, with only two interruptions. When the Venstre split came in 1888 he stood in the front rank of the "pure" Venstre, and the resulting election defeat halted his national career.

Det sette ein brå stopp for den rikspolitiske karrieren hans

body.zh-Hant: 1908年自由黨（Venstre）分裂時，他成為新成立的自由派黨（Frisinna Venstre）的代表人物，並於1909年當選議員。1910年，保守的右派黨（Høgre）與自由派黨的聯盟勝選後組成政府，他出任首相，政府任期為1910至1912年。1912年1月28日他在克里斯蒂安尼亞的農村青年會演講，熱情談及少年時對語言運動（målsaka）的熱愛，右派黨視為挑釁；1912年2月政府陷入危機，右派黨退出，改組失敗後他放棄。
body.en: When Venstre split in 1908 he became the front figure of the newly formed Frisinna Venstre, and he was elected to the Storting in 1909. In 1910 he became prime minister in the government formed by the victorious coalition of Høgre and Frisinna Venstre, and he held the office in 1910-1912. On 28 January 1912 he gave a speech to the Bondeungdomslaget in Kristiania in which he warmly acknowledged his youthful devotion to the language movement, which provoked Høgre. A government crisis followed in February 1912; Høgre withdrew, and after a failed attempt at reconstruction Konow gave up.

heading.en: Later years and the Nobel Committee

body.zh-Hant: 1912年他再度參選，卻敗給一名自由黨人，從此離開挪威政壇，餘生住在斯滕德。他在1913至1922年任諾貝爾委員會的候補委員；1922年8月21日起成為正式委員，直到1924年3月15日去世。
body.en: He stood again in 1912 but lost to a Venstre candidate, which ended his career in Norwegian politics, and he lived the rest of his life at Stend. He was a deputy member of the Nobel Committee from 1913 to 1922 and a full member from 21 August 1922 until his death on 15 March 1924.
